result.rationale: The diff shows `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` in poll_feed.rb with no nil check, and `sidekiq_options retry: false`. If a feed item lacks a content element, i.content would be nil and .scrub would raise NoMethodError, aborting the loop; no error handling exists in poll_feed. This is a plausible correctness defect, though whether any given feed has content-less items depends on runtime data.

judged_text: `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` raises NoMethodError when a feed item has no content element (nil), and `sidekiq_options retry: false` ensures the run is not retried. Any feed containing a single summary-only or content-less item (common for Atom feeds with only <summary>) makes every hourly poll die at that item, so all articles after it are never imported and the feature fails silently with no retry and no error surfaced to the operator.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` assumes `i.content` is non-nil. If a feed item lacks a `<content>` element (common in Atom feeds that only provide `<summary>`), `i.content` will be `nil` and calling `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the job mid-`rss.items.each`. Because the job sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, it will not retry after such a failure, so subsequent items in the feed won't be imported until the next run and the same item can keep breaking imports.
